title: MZ Is there a plugin that can compare a player’s choices to choices that other players made in their playthroughs?

posts.author: Magenta-Fantasies
posts.body:
I’ve played through Brok the InvestiGator (which is a phenomenal game, by the way) several times now, and one of my favorite things about this game is that after you beat it, you can view a chart that shows all the choices you’ve made in that playthrough. Not only that, but you can see how your choices compare to those that you made in previous playthroughs AND choices made by other players! E.g. in the screenshot that I attached, you can see that for the choice I highlighted in the lower right corner, 39% of other players made the same choice.
While it's structured differently, my game Outcasts of the Rift also has branching storylines and many different ways for players to solve problems.
For my purposes, I would be fine with the plugin comparing only the player’s most recent playthrough to other players’ most recent playthroughs. Unlike Brok the InvestiGator, it wouldn’t need to store the data from all the player’s past playthroughs, although that would also be cool if it’s not too much of an extra challenge to implement.
I know some level of interconnectivity between multiple copies of the same game is possible through plugins (e.g. there are plugins for adding multiplayer modes to games made in RPG Maker,) so I’m wondering if this is possible, if anyone has ever done anything like this in a game made in RPG Maker, or if there is a plugin or plugins that would make something like this possible.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: You'd have to have some online service like Firebase and be paying for hosting that data. AFAIK there's no RPG Maker plugin for it.

posts.author: Magenta-Fantasies
posts.body:
AquaEcho said:
You'd have to have some online service like Firebase and be paying for hosting that data. AFAIK there's no RPG Maker plugin for it.
Click to expand...
I’ve done a modest amount of searching, and unfortunately I think you’re right.
It looks like the closest thing I could do would be to collect global data from each playthrough of an individual player. I know of one plugin that can save global data (e.g. Global Data by Casper Gaming
https://casper-gaming.itch.io/cgmz-global-data
) and I know I’ve seen others.
By storing global data, at least players could compare their choices in one playthrough to choices they made in a previous playthrough or playthroughs, but I don’t think that’s anywhere near as interesting as being able to compare choices they made to what choices
other
players made in their playthroughs.
Thanks for your help, though.
